sections.h2: India's tax treaties cover 97 countries, out of 173 instruments on record

chart.title: Only 97 of the 173 instruments on record are comprehensive agreements
chart.sub: Count of DTAA-related instruments on the Income Tax Department database.
chart.source: Income Tax Department DTAA database, updated 30 July 2026.

sections.means: Of the 173 instruments on record, 97 are comprehensive agreements, with the rest made up of limited agreements, TIEAs, protocols and synthesised texts.

sections.h2: Tax treaties reach 97 countries; the nine new FTAs reach 38

chart.title: Tax treaties cover 97 countries, far more than the 38 in new FTAs
chart.sub: Countries with a comprehensive tax treaty, against countries in the nine new-generation FTAs.
chart.source: Income Tax Department DTAA database; Ministry of Commerce & Industry, PIB, 6 March 2026.

sections.means: Tax treaties decide how income is taxed, and India has them with 97 countries, far more than the 38 covered by its new trade agreements.
